records.title: Structure RAGDrive as a DDD hexagonal monorepo
records.summary: We will structure the platform as a monorepo of deployable apps over a set of bounded contexts, each context following ports-and-adapters (hexagonal) layering.

records.title: Use Voyage voyage-3-large as the default embedding model
records.summary: We will use **Voyage `voyage-3-large` at 1024 dimensions** as the default embedding model, behind an `EmbeddingProvider` port with adapters for all four candidates.

records.title: Support both service-account and OAuth authentication for Google Drive
records.summary: We will support **both modes, selectable per document source** in the configuration area, behind a single `SourceCredential` port.

records.title: Hybrid dense/BM25 retrieval fused with RRF and a cross-encoder rerank
Provision RAGDrive with Terraform across Azure, AWS and GCP
records.summary: We will write Terraform as a set of **cloud-agnostic root modules over per-cloud implementation modules**, with a shared contract each cloud must satisfy: managed Postgres with the `vector` extension, a container runtime for the API and frontend, a KMS-backed key for credential envelope encryption (see [ADR-0003](0003-dual-mode-google-drive-authentication.md)), an object store for raw document snapshots, and an OTLP-compatible telemetry sink.

records.title: Enforce a conventional-commit auto-commit hook and ADR-as-code
records.summary: We will treat both as automation rather than discipline.

records.title: Server-authoritative session context, Redux-cached and hydrated at chat inception
records.summary: We will keep the **server authoritative** for session context and use Redux as a **hydrated projection** of it.

records.title: Visualise the context budget in Three.js with user-directed truncation
records.summary: We will render the context budget as a **segmented volumetric meter** in Three.js, sharing a WebGL context with the retrieval trace (see [ADR-0009](0009-stream-and-visualise-the-retrieval-reasoning-trace.md)) and reading from the Redux projection (see [ADR-0007](0007-client-cached-session-context-hydrated-at-inception.md)).

records.title: Stream the LangGraph retrieval and reasoning trace to a visualised timeline
records.summary: We will stream each LangGraph node transition to the client over SSE and render it as a **live trace timeline**, escalating to the shared Three.js canvas only when the graph actually branches.

records.title: Evaluation as a first-class bounded context, configurable from the UI
records.summary: We will model **Evaluation as its own bounded context** with `Dataset`, `Case`, `Run`, and `Score` as aggregates, exposed through the configuration UI.

records.title: HNSW over IVFFlat, and a trigger-maintained tsvector
Use Postgres ts_rank_cd for lexical ranking rather than true BM25
records.summary: We will use `ts_rank_cd(search_vector, query, 32)` for lexical ranking, and treat ADR-0004's "BM25" as shorthand for "lexical relevance ranking" rather than a literal algorithm commitment.

records.title: Voyage rerank-2.5 as the default cross-encoder, with a self-hosted escape hatch
records.summary: We will use **Voyage `rerank-2.5`** by default, behind the existing `Reranker` port, and treat a self-hosted adapter as a supported configuration rather than a hypothetical one.

records.title: Retry vendor rate limits with a delay floor, not full jitter from zero
records.summary: We will retry rate limits with exponential backoff, jittered **between a floor and the ceiling** rather than between zero and the ceiling.

records.title: The SSE client must tolerate any spec-legal line ending, not just LF
records.summary: `streamChat`'s buffer handling and `parseFrame` both normalise line endings to `\n` before doing any `\n`-based parsing, and both are covered by tests that exercise the failure mode directly rather than only the parser's happy path.
